Extract information from documents and forms by using Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools; Extract information from images by using Content Understanding; Extract information from audio and video by using Content Understanding; Build a lightweight application with information extraction capabilities by using Content Understanding

toc.title: Extracting from images, audio and video

html:
1What Content Understanding does

Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools is a Foundry Tool that "uses generative AI to process and ingest many types of content, including documents, images, videos and audio" into a user-defined output format.

You give it You get back
A document or form (PDF, scan, image of a page) Text, layout, and fields such as invoice number, date, total
An image A summary and fields you define
Audio (a call recording) A transcript, a summary, speaker labels
Video Key frames, a transcript, chapter segments

The output is Markdown (good for search and retrieval) or JSON that matches the schema you define.

2Analyzers

An analyzer is the recipe that says what to extract from a type of content.

Analyzer Meaning
Prebuilt analyzer Ready-made for common scenarios; names include prebuilt-invoice for invoices, and search analyzers for images (imageSearch), video (videoSearch) and audio (audioSearch)
Custom analyzer One you design for your own content, with your own fields
Exam tip

. "Common document type such as an invoice" → prebuilt analyzer. "Our own form with our own fields" → custom analyzer.

3Extracting from documents and forms

Content extraction reads the content: OCR text, selection marks (check boxes), barcodes, formulas and the layout (paragraphs, sections, tables).

Field extraction returns the values you ask for. Three ways to get a value:

Method Meaning Example
Extract Take the value exactly as it appears (documents only) The invoice total printed on the page
Classify Choose a category from a list "Invoice", "Receipt" or "Contract"
Generate Write a value with generative AI A one-sentence summary

Two quality features:

  • Confidence score: a number from 0 to 1 for each extracted field: how reliable it is. Use it to send low-confidence values to a person to check.
  • Grounding: shows where in the document each value was found.
Exam tip

. A low confidence score means the value may be wrong, so a person should check it.

4Extracting from images, audio and video

Content Prebuilt analyzer result
Image (imageSearch) A summary field
Audio (audioSearch) Transcript, summary, speaker labeling
Video (videoSearch) Key frames, transcript, chapter segments

This makes recordings and videos searchable and lets an app pull out specific facts, for example action items from a meeting recording. For custom needs you add your own fields to a custom analyzer. [Verify live] for the current analyzers.

5A lightweight extraction application

The pattern is again client, one call, read the result. Analysis can take time, so the call is a long-running operation that returns a poller you wait on.

import os
from azure.ai.contentunderstanding import ContentUnderstandingClient
from azure.ai.contentunderstanding.models import AnalysisInput
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential

endpoint = os.environ["CONTENTUNDERSTANDING_ENDPOINT"]
key = os.environ["CONTENTUNDERSTANDING_KEY"]

client = ContentUnderstandingClient(endpoint=endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(key))

poller = client.begin_analyze(
    analyzer_id="prebuilt-invoice",
    inputs=[AnalysisInput(url=invoice_url)],
)
result = poller.result()
Line Meaning
pip install --pre azure-ai-contentunderstanding The package (a pre-release at the time of writing)
os.environ[...] Endpoint and key come from environment variables
ContentUnderstandingClient(...) The client for the service
begin_analyze(analyzer_id=..., inputs=[...]) Starts the analysis with a chosen analyzer on an input (here a URL)
poller.result() Waits and returns the analysis result: fields, confidence, content

Use API version 2025-11-01 (generally available) for production; a preview version has newer features. [Verify live]

Exam tip

. "begin_" in the method name means a long-running operation: you get a poller and call result(). The analyzer id chooses what is extracted. Change the analyzer to change the type of content or fields.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors receives thousands of supplier invoices as PDFs and wants invoice number, date and total as fields. Which option fits?

  • ASpeech synthesis with a neural voice
  • BImage generation with a GPT-Image model
  • CLanguage detection on the invoice text
  • DContent Understanding with a prebuilt invoice analyzer
Show the answer

Answer: D. A prebuilt invoice analyzer extracts the common invoice fields from documents.

S2A confidence score of 0.42 is returned for the extracted total. What is a sensible action?

  • ATrust it and process the invoice without checking
  • BSend the value to a person for review
  • CDelete the document and ask for a new one
  • DRaise the temperature and analyze again
Show the answer

Answer: B. Low confidence means the value may be wrong, so a person should check it.

S3A call-center wants transcripts, summaries and speaker labels from recordings. Which kind of analyzer fits?

  • AAn audio analyzer such as audioSearch
  • BA document invoice analyzer for PDFs
  • CAn image generation model for pictures
  • DA key phrase extractor for video
Show the answer

Answer: A. The prebuilt audio analyzer returns a transcript, a summary and speaker labels.

S4Which field extraction method copies a value exactly as it appears in a document?

  • AExtract
  • BGenerate
  • CClassify
  • DSummarize
Show the answer

Answer: A. Extract takes values as they appear; classify chooses a category; generate writes a value.

S5In the sample code, what does poller.result() do?

  • AStarts a new analyzer for the next file in the folder
  • BDeletes the endpoint of the service and its key
  • CWaits for the analysis and returns the result
  • DPlays the audio of the document aloud
Show the answer

Answer: C. begin_analyze starts a long-running operation, and result() waits for and returns the outcome.

S6A company has its own form with unusual fields and no prebuilt analyzer fits. What should it create?

  • AA new Azure region for the service
  • BA larger context window for the model
  • CA speech voice for the form
  • DA custom analyzer with its own fields
Show the answer

Answer: D. A custom analyzer lets you define your own fields for your own content.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which four kinds of content does Content Understanding process?

Show the answer

Documents, images, audio and video.

R2What are the three field extraction methods?

Show the answer

Extract, classify and generate.

R3What range does a confidence score have?

Show the answer

0 to 1.

R4What does grounding show?

Show the answer

Where in the content each value was found.

R5What two output formats are available?

Show the answer

Markdown and JSON matching your schema.

R6What does a method name starting with begin_ indicate?

Show the answer

A long-running operation that returns a poller.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Service Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools: documents, images, audio, video
Analyzers prebuilt (prebuilt-invoice, imageSearch, audioSearch, videoSearch) or custom
Documents OCR, selection marks, barcodes, formulas, layout; fields by extract, classify, generate
Quality confidence 0 to 1; grounding shows the source region
Output Markdown (search) or JSON (schema)
Code ContentUnderstandingClient; begin_analyze(analyzer_id, inputs); poller.result()
